cards.answer: Bard is a support mage who combines magic-damage attacks with conditional stuns and portals through terrain. His damage benefits from AP, while his ultimate puts allies and enemies into stasis.
cards.counterplay: Avoid lining up with terrain or other enemies, and approach his portals cautiously.

citations.quote: Name: Bard. Official role tags: Support, Mage.
Bard attracts lesser spirits that assist with his basic attacks to deal extra magic damage.
If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both.
Bard opens a portal in nearby terrain.

facts.claim: combines magic-damage attacks with conditional stuns and portals through terrain

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing his binding setup and terrain access helps avoid picks.

cards.answer: Traveler's Call: Meeps empower Bard's basic attacks with bonus magic damage. Collecting chimes grants experience, restores mana and provides out-of-combat movement speed; it also upgrades Meeps to slow enemies and damage an area around and behind their target.
cards.counterplay: Respect empowered attacks and avoid clustering behind his attack target.

cards.answer: Cosmic Binding: Bard fires a bolt that deals magic damage and slows the first enemy hit, then continues behind them. If it reaches terrain, it stuns that enemy; if it reaches another enemy, it damages the additional enemy and stuns both.
cards.counterplay: Avoid lining up with terrain or other enemies behind you.

If the bolt hits terrain or a second enemy, it stuns both targets for the same duration, dealing the same damage to the secondary target.

cards.answer: Caretaker's Shrine: Bard places a shrine that grows stronger over time. Bard or an ally can consume it for healing and a burst of movement speed; an enemy stepping on it destroys it.
cards.counterplay: Step on exposed enemy shrines when safe to deny their healing.

Shrines may last indefinitely until being consumed by a champion moving over them.

cards.priority_reason: Shrines sustain his team and can be denied by enemies.

cards.answer: Magical Journey: Bard opens a one-way portal through terrain that allies and enemies can use. Bard and his allies travel faster through it, and travelers are revealed during passage. Champions cannot enter while immobilized or grounded.
cards.counterplay: Check the exit before following Bard, and consider guarding it instead of chasing through.

citations.quote: Bard opens a portal in nearby terrain. Allies and enemies alike can take a one-way trip through that terrain by moving into the portal.

citations.quote: Bard and allies travel through the portal at 33% increased speed.
A champion can pass through the corridor by selecting it while within proximity of it, becoming revealed during the travel.

citations.quote: Magical Journey cannot be taken while immobilized or grounded.

facts.claim: Champions cannot enter while immobilized or grounded.

cards.priority_reason: Shared portal access and unequal travel speeds shape chase decisions.

cards.answer: Tempered Fate: Bard sends energy arcing to a location, briefly putting affected allies and enemies into stasis. It also affects minions, monsters and turrets, including epic monsters.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the landing area and prepare for affected champions to return to the fight.
